rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Invidian Drivers are pretty much
the same as any other Drivers.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0002
rows.name:
We use Core Crystals that have
been cleansed over in Acedia.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I was the same, but many people can't
resonate with Core Crystals as-is.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Drivers are indispensable
for strengthening your forces.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Drivers are indispensable for building
military strength, both for us and for
other countries.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0006
rows.name:
So we don't have much choice but
to rely on Acedia for cleansing.

rows.label: tlk43320341_03_msg0007
rows.name:
That's why Acedia holds so much
authority.
